d.name: Cutter
d.xptrigger: Address a challenge with violence or coercion.

features.name: Battleborn
features.text: You may expend your special armor to reduce harm from an attack in combat or to push yourself during a fight.

features.name: Bodyguard
features.text: When you protect a teammate, take +1d to your resistance roll. When you gather information to anticipate possible threats in the current situation, you get +1 effect.

features.name: Ghost Fighter
features.text: You may imbue your hands, melee weapons, or tools with spirit energy. You gain potency in combat vs. the supernatural. You may grapple with spirits to restrain and capture them.

features.name: Leader
features.text: When you Command a cohort in combat, they continue to fight when they would otherwise break. They gain potency and 1 armor.

features.name: Mule
features.text: Your load limits are higher. Light: 5. Normal: 7. Heavy: 8.

features.name: Not to Be Trifled With
features.text: You can push yourself to do one of the following: perform a feat of physical force that verges on the superhuman, or engage a small gang on equal footing in close combat.

features.name: Savage
features.text: When you unleash physical violence, it is especially frightening. When you Command a frightened target, take +1d.

features.name: Vigorous
features.text: You recover from harm faster. Permanently fill in one of your healing clock segments. Take +1d to healing treatment rolls.

items.x:
A dangerous and intimidating fighter.

XP trigger: Address a challenge with violence or coercion.

Playbook items: Fine hand weapon, Fine heavy weapon, Scary weapon or tool, Manacles & chain, Rage essence vial, Spiritbane charm.

d.name: Hound
d.xptrigger: Address a challenge with tracking or violence.

features.name: Sharpshooter
features.text: You can push yourself to make a ranged attack at extreme distance beyond what is normal, or to suppress fire against several targets.

features.name: Focused
features.text: You may expend your special armor to resist a consequence of surprise or mental harm, or to push yourself for ranged combat or tracking.

features.name: Ghost Hunter
features.text: Your hunting pet is imbued with spirit energy. It gains potency when tracking or fighting the supernatural, and gains an arcane ability.

features.name: Scout
features.text: When you gather information to locate a target, you get +1 effect. When you hide in a prepared position or use camouflage, you get +1d to rolls to avoid detection.

features.name: Survivor
features.text: From hard won experience or occult ritual, you are immune to the poisonous miasma of the deathlands and are able to subsist on the strange flora and fauna there. You get +1 stress box.

features.name: Tough as Nails
features.text: Penalties from harm are one level less severe (though level 4 harm is still fatal).

features.name: Vengeful
features.text: You gain an additional xp trigger: You got payback against someone who harmed you or someone you care about. If your crew helped you get payback, also mark crew xp.

features.name: Veteran
features.text: Choose a special ability from another source.

items.x:
A deadly sharpshooter and tracker.

XP trigger: Address a challenge with tracking or violence.

Playbook items: Fine pair of pistols, Fine long rifle, Electroplasmic ammunition, A trained hunting pet, Spyglass, Spiritbane charm.

d.name: Leech
d.xptrigger: Address a challenge with technical skill or mayhem.

features.name: Alchemist
features.text: When you invent or craft a creation with alchemical features, take +1 result level to your roll. You begin with one special formula already known.

features.name: Analyst
features.text: During downtime, you get two ticks to distribute among any long term project clocks that involve investigation or learning a new formula or design plan.

features.name: Artificer
features.text: When you invent or craft a creation with spark-craft features, take +1 result level to your roll. You begin with one special design already known.

features.name: Fortitude
features.text: You may expend your special armor to resist a consequence of fatigue, weakness, or chemical effects, or to push yourself when working with technical skill or handling alchemicals.

features.name: Ghost Ward
features.text: You know how to Wreck an area with arcane substances and methods so it is either anathema or enticing to spirits.

features.name: Physicker
features.text: You can Tinker with bones, blood, and bodily humours to treat wounds or stabilize the dying. You may study a malady or corpse. Everyone in your crew gets +1d to their healing treatment rolls.

features.name: Saboteur
features.text: When you Wreck, the work is much quieter than it should be and the damage is very well-hidden from casual inspection.

features.name: Venomous
features.text: Choose a drug or poison to which you have become immune. You can push yourself to secrete it through your skin or saliva or exhale it as a vapor.

items.x:
A saboteur and technician.

XP trigger: Address a challenge with technical skill or mayhem.

Playbook items: Fine tinkering tools, Fine wrecking tools, Blowgun & darts, syringes, Bandolier (3 uses), Gadgets.

d.name: Lurk
d.xptrigger: Address a challenge with stealth or evasion.

features.name: Infiltrator
features.text: You are not affected by quality or Tier when you bypass security measures.

features.name: Ambush
features.text: When you attack from hiding or spring a trap, you get +1d.

features.name: Daredevil
features.text: When you roll a desperate action, you get +1d to your roll if you also take -1d to any resistance rolls against consequences from your action.

features.name: The Devil's Footsteps
features.text: When you push yourself, choose one: perform a feat of athletics that verges on the superhuman, or maneuver to confuse your enemies so they mistakenly attack each other.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Choose one of your action ratings. When you lead a group action using that action, you can suffer only 1 stress at most regardless of the number of failed rolls.

features.name: Ghost Veil
features.text: You may shift partially into the ghost field, becoming shadowy and insubstantial for a few moments. Take 2 stress when you shift, plus 1 stress for each extra feature.

features.name: Reflexes
features.text: When there is a question about who acts first, the answer is you.

features.name: Shadow
features.text: You may expend your special armor to resist a consequence from detection or security measures, or to push yourself for a feat of athletics or stealth.

items.x:
A stealthy infiltrator and burglar.

XP trigger: Address a challenge with stealth or evasion.

Playbook items: Fine lockpicks, Fine shadow cloak, Light climbing gear, Silence potion vial, Dark-sight goggles.

d.name: Slide
d.xptrigger: Address a challenge with deception or influence.

features.name: Rook's Gambit
features.text: Take 2 stress to roll your best action rating while performing a different action. Say how you adapt your skill to this use.

features.name: Cloak & Dagger
features.text: When you use a disguise or other form of covert misdirection, you get +1d to rolls to confuse or deflect suspicion. When you throw off your disguise, the resulting surprise gives you the initiative.

features.name: Ghost Voice
features.text: You know the secret method to interact with a ghost or demon as if it was a normal human, regardless of how wild or feral it appears.

features.name: Like Looking into a Mirror
features.text: You can always tell when someone is lying to you.

features.name: A Little Something on the Side
features.text: At the end of each downtime phase, you earn +2 stash.

features.name: Mesmerism
features.text: When you Sway someone, you may cause them to forget that it happened until they next interact with you.

features.name: Subterfuge
features.text: You may expend your special armor to resist a consequence from suspicion or persuasion, or to push yourself for subterfuge.

features.name: Trust in Me
features.text: You get +1d vs. a target with whom you have an intimate relationship.

items.x:
A subtle manipulator and spy.

XP trigger: Address a challenge with deception or influence.

Playbook items: Fine clothes & jewelry, Fine disguise kit, Fine loaded dice, trick cards, Trance powder, A cane-sword, Spiritbane charm.

d.name: Spider
d.xptrigger: Address a challenge with calculation or conspiracy.

features.name: Foresight
features.text: Three times per score, you can assist a teammate without paying stress. Tell us how you prepared for this.

features.name: Calculating
features.text: Due to your careful planning, during downtime, you may give yourself or another crew member +1 downtime action.

features.name: Connected
features.text: During downtime, you get +1 result level when you acquire an asset or reduce heat.

features.name: Functioning Vice
features.text: When you indulge your vice, you may adjust the dice outcome by 1 or 2. An ally who joins you may do the same.

features.name: Ghost Contract
features.text: When you shake on a deal, you and your partner both bear a mark of your oath. Breaking it brings level 3 harm, Cursed.

features.name: Jail Bird
features.text: When incarcerated, your wanted level counts as 1 less, your Tier as 1 more, and you gain +1 faction status with a faction you help on the inside.

features.name: Mastermind
features.text: You may expend your special armor to protect a teammate, or to push yourself when you gather information or work on a long-term project.

features.name: Weaving the Web
features.text: You gain +1d to Consort when you gather information on a target for a score. You get +1d to the engagement roll for that score.

items.x:
A devious mastermind.

XP trigger: Address a challenge with calculation or conspiracy.

Playbook items: Fine cover identity, Fine bottle of whiskey, Blueprints, Vial of slumber essence, Concealed palm pistol, Spiritbane charm.

d.name: Whisper
d.xptrigger: Address a challenge with knowledge or arcane power.

features.name: Compel
features.text: You can Attune to the ghost field to force a nearby ghost to appear and obey a command you give it.

features.name: Ghost Mind
features.text: You're always aware of supernatural entities in your presence. Take +1d when you gather information about the supernatural.

features.name: Iron Will
features.text: You're immune to the terror that some supernatural entities inflict on sight. When you make a resistance roll with Resolve, take +1d.

features.name: Occultist
features.text: You know the secret ways of the Forgotten Gods. Take +1d when you Consort with them or their servants, and +1d to resist harm from their minions.

features.name: Ritual
features.text: You can Study an occult ritual (or create a new one) to summon a supernatural effect or being.

features.name: Strange Methods
features.text: When you invent or craft a creation with arcane features, take +1 result level to your roll. You begin with one arcane design already known.

features.name: Tempest
features.text: You can push yourself to unleash a stroke of lightning as a weapon or summon a storm in your immediate vicinity.

features.name: Warded
features.text: You may expend your special armor to resist a supernatural consequence, or to push yourself when you deal with arcane forces.

items.x:
An arcane adept and channeler.

XP trigger: Address a challenge with knowledge or arcane power.

Playbook items: Fine lightning hook, Fine spirit mask, Electroplasm vials, Spirit bottles (2), Ghost key, Demonbane charm.
